usage: gedo_feedback.py [-h] [--dir DIR] {status,add,list,show,issue,reported,close,validate} ...

Record what goes wrong with Gedo, for Gedo's own backlog

positional arguments:
  {status,add,list,show,issue,reported,close,validate}
    status              Whether recording is on, and the entry counts
    add                 Record a new entry
    list                List entries (open and reported by default)
    show                Show one entry
    issue               Title and body of the Gedo issue for an open entry
    reported            Mark an entry as reported, with its issue URL
    close               Close an entry (fixed in Gedo, not a Gedo problem, ...)
    validate            Check every entry

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dir DIR             Project directory (default: current directory)
